3D building study

A small town, seen in the round.

Three building shapes viewed in the Hometown camera: a windmill, a kitchen, and a house. This is a look test for scale, silhouette, and the meeting point between 2D art and simple 3D form.

Overall source report: pass.

What this study shows

These are visual readings from the rendered plates.

What holds at default size

The roofs and windmill sails carry the read. The bread and flower accents are small at this distance.

Where the styles diverge

The sprite arches and scalloped roofs become straighter low-poly edges in these models.

The rear views

The kitchen and house have plain wall planes on their backs, with less character than their fronts.
